rounds.prompt: For the web UI surface, create two new main nav right-aligned dropdown buttons, one for Skills and one for Sites. The right-aligned button order should be Skills, Sites, Settings, and New Goal. Yes, that is a rename of Controls to Settings. Move the menus from Settings (formerly Controls) to the appropriate new menu for Sites and Skills. Add a separator to the new menus for New Skill, New Site, Manage Skills, and Manage Sites. Ensure you use the standardized styles and layout we already have in the app.

skill.prompt:
## Quality review

Run tests to ensure the Goal's implementation passes meaningful tests. Do not remove meaningful tests. Remove deprecated or meaningless tests. Use the best available tools for the testing the Goal. The quality gate passes when the system is operational and meaningful tests have passed.

If issues outside the Goal’s scope block progress, investigate and fix them or use an evidence-backed workaround, preserving required checks and documenting what you changed.
